title: Kitchen counters and backsplash
summary: Old counters and tile out, dark quartz and a white subway backsplash in, with new pendants over the island.

before.alt: Kitchen mid-demolition, counters papered over and the old glass-tile backsplash half removed

after.alt: Finished kitchen with dark counters, white subway-tile backsplash and two glass pendant lights

title: Sink and mosaic counter
summary: A cracked double basin swapped for a single stainless sink, set in a flower mosaic counter and splash.

before.alt: Old white double sink with the surrounding tile counter torn out and taped off

after.alt: New stainless single-basin sink framed in white flower mosaic tile

title: Walk-in shower rebuild
summary: Stained tile and a fogged door replaced with subway tile, a recessed niche and a grab bar.

before.alt: Narrow tiled shower with a frosted glass door and stained grout on the floor

after.alt: Rebuilt shower in white subway tile with dark grout, a recessed niche and a grab bar

title: Plank accent wall
summary: Mixed-tone wood planks laid out, sorted and set floor to ceiling across a blank conference-room wall.

before.alt: Blank wall marked with blue tape, wood planks laid out on the floor in front of it

after.alt: Finished wall covered floor to ceiling in staggered natural wood planks, behind a conference table

title: Closet into wraparound shelving
summary: A single rod and shelf became four levels of built-in shelving that turn the corners.

before.alt: Closet with one rod and shelf, packed with luggage and a vacuum

after.alt: The same closet emptied and fitted with painted wraparound shelves on four levels

title: Outdoor kitchen island
summary: Framed, sheathed, stuccoed and tiled — a two-level island under the backyard pergola.

before.alt: Plywood frame for an outdoor island with tile samples laid on top

after.alt: Finished stucco island with grey plank-tile countertops under a wooden pergola

title: Glass block wall opened up
summary: A glass block wall came out to make a walk-through shower with a view to the tub and window.

before.alt: Bathroom wall with a tall column of glass blocks and a vent above

after.alt: Open walk-through shower in white tile, looking through to a soaking tub and window

title: Kitchen flooring
summary: Old flooring and adhesive scraped back to the slab, then wood-look plank laid wall to wall.

before.alt: Kitchen floor stripped to concrete with dark adhesive stains and a few new planks laid

after.alt: Finished grey wood-look plank floor running under a stainless fridge and cabinets

title: Shower door and floor
summary: New floor tile and a frosted sliding door in place of the old swinging panel.

before.alt: Shower with a worn hexagon-tile floor and a scratched hinged glass door

after.alt: Same shower with new patterned floor tile and a frosted sliding glass door

title: Pantry shelving
summary: An empty coat closet fitted out as a pantry, with six fixed shelves top to bottom.

before.alt: Empty closet with a single rod and shelf

after.alt: The same closet fitted with six painted shelves from floor to ceiling

title: Water shutoff box
summary: Dug out around the main shutoff, set a proper valve box, and poured a new pad around it.

before.alt: Open hole in a concrete walkway exposing the main water shutoff valve

after.alt: New square concrete pad with a round black valve-box lid set flush

title: Gas meter pad
summary: Broken slab by the gas meter cut out and repoured, with the access cover set level.

before.alt: Wet concrete being screeded in a cut-out section of walkway by a gas meter

after.alt: Cured concrete pad by the gas meter with a round access cover set flush
